This game is ridiculously difficult. I play single-player, I have zero desire to interact with other people while I game. In single-player mode the game throws everything its got directly at you, not at your team, and they are rarely ever there when you actually need them. After almost 100 hours, I'll stand by this. You don't get to respawn if you play single player. That's all the difference.

I have to say that this has to be among one of my favorite games I've played recently, the combat is unique having gunplay and good melee mechanics. The armor customization is pretty good, having a healthy mix of having to unlock pieces as well as some microtransactions. The campaign was really enjoyable, even as someone who isn't really knowledgeable on the Warhammer lore, and overall this game is quite enjoyable, especially since you can pick it up for $20 on sale, definitely worth the money.

My only gripes are that performance can be here or there, which makes sense given that there can be a ton of crap on screen at once, and it still performs fairly well. The year 1+2 pass bundle doesn't include (I think) 2 of the cosmetic packs, which kinda sucks. My biggest gripe gameplay wise is that sometimes it can be hard to read an enemy's body language, notably the vortex beast (a boss of one of the pve operations), and one of the other bosses. Some of it's a skill issue, this game definitely has a high skill ceiling, but I think a little bit of tweaking could definitely help. The grind can also feel a bit long, however that's because there is just so much stuff that you can unlock. 

Overall, I would say if you are interested definitely consider picking up, ESPECIALLY on a sale. I tend to play this game with my dad and I have to say it's a pretty good time overall, there is also pvp, but I haven't played that yet so I can't really speak on it. 8/10 :)

This game is exactly what I have been waiting for and I don’t even know I was missing. 

There are issues. Don’t get me wrong. For instance, the input lag. It is so bad on occasion that automatic weapons stop firing when you never let off the trigger and you still have ammo. The map gets overwhelmed by enemies very quickly which isn’t an issue, that’s the fun part. My personal issue is when you hit parry, your frame rate drops to nothing out of nowhere because enemies just spawned or someone is typing, 2-3 enemies hit you because they can still move and shoot just fine somehow, your toon parries directly THROUGH  the attack, the frames catch up and everything gets super fast for a second, then it levels out. Making you question your sanity and ability to hit a button because the timing is always either all over the place or useless to try. Granted this usually only happens in the real thick of it, but that is also when you need things to work the most. 

The other issue I have is with the “semi useful roll on occasion” referred to as “dodge” in the game. All I can say about this is that there is a perfect dodge, and then there is, you might as well have stood there, set the controller down, made a cup of tea, had a nap, then come back to see if you had any health left to try and keep playing. 

That being said, this game is getting better. It is being tweaked by the devs and I have hope it will keep improving. The overall experience has me coming back for more every day I can play it. It is a game that is equally suited and enjoyable by casual players and the hardcore alike. I see it being expanded with more classes and weapons in the future which will make it even more replay-able. 

Overall it is very worth it if you are looking for a grindy game to lose a few hundred hours into without even noticing. Just as much as it is easy to lose thousands of hours trying to master it. Which I intend to do.
